$comment: Packaged app size, tracked per PR. CI re-measures every image it builds and fails when these numbers are stale by more than toleranceMb, or when an image exceeds its budget. Regenerate locally with `npm run dist && npm run size`; for win-x64, copy the block the failing CI job prints. Budgets carry ~10-15% headroom over the measured size — enough for ordinary growth, tight enough that an accidental fat dependency trips before it merges.
